"Mainland Conducts First Fisheries Scientific Survey East of Taiwan [title] At midnight in mid-July, in the waters east of Taiwan Island, the *Lanhai 201*—a comprehensive fisheries scientific research vessel from the East China Sea Fisheries Research Institute (under the Chinese Academy of Fishery Sciences, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs)—was a hive of activity. As the survey nets were slowly hoisted and the collected samples poured into baskets, a pungent, briny scent of the sea filled the air. Yet, Dr. Shi Yongchuang, an associate researcher at the institute, excitedly removed his mask and leaned in close to examine these small creatures from relatively unfamiliar waters. For the research team—whose members have an average age of just 35—this marked their first foray into this traditional fishing ground of Chinese fishermen. To them, this was a voyage carrying forward a historic mission. They also took pride in arriving in these waters under Chinese jurisdiction amidst "roiling waves." On July 23—seven days after the *Lanhai 201* set sail—the comprehensive scientific survey of resources and the environment in the waters east of Taiwan Island was officially announced. During those seven days, *Global Times* reporters accompanying the *Lanhai 201* on its pioneering voyage not only witnessed the beauty of these "ancestral waters" but also personally experienced harassment by external forces. Zheng Hanfeng, the chief scientist of the expedition and deputy director of the East China Sea Fisheries Research Institute, told reporters that the voyage's most significant milestone was filling the gap in fisheries surveys for the waters east of Taiwan, thereby completing the geographic coverage of scientific surveys regarding fisheries resources within my country's Exclusive Economic Zone. Scientific researchers aboard the *Lanhai 201* employ various technical methods to survey fishery resources and the marine environment in the waters off eastern Taiwan. (Photo by Hu Yuwei) "Fulfilling a mentor's wish: filling the blank spots on the coastal survey map" Working around the clock without sleep became the norm for the scientific team aboard the *Lanhai 201* over the course of seven days. Even after midnight, the deck and laboratories remained brightly lit. What truly excited the team were the successive hauls of the catch; much like opening "blind boxes," they eagerly anticipated a new surprise with every net brought aboard. Even with a small fish that might seem unremarkable to the average person, Dr. Zhao Guoqing and his colleagues from the East China Sea Fisheries Research Institute would meticulously identify and process the specimen. They measured body length and weight one by one, and carefully performed dissections to record the stage of gonad development and stomach fullness. Dr. Zhao explained to the *Global Times* reporter that these seemingly trivial basic biological parameters serve as the cornerstone for subsequent biodiversity analysis and resource assessment. Populations of the same fish species inhabiting different waters can exhibit significant differences in characteristics due to geographical isolation and environmental factors. Zhang Hanye, a researcher and leader of the fish study group, elaborated: "The waters off eastern Taiwan are particularly unique; the seabed features rare, precipitous drops—with depths plunging to between 3,000 and 5,000 meters—which contrasts sharply with the continental shelf characteristics of other domestic coastal areas, where depths typically range from a few dozen to a few hundred meters. Being able to collect firsthand data from these waters—which are part of our own coastal territory—gives us much greater confidence in our scientific analysis." Zhao Guoqing’s focus and dedication stem from a deep sense of mission. He shared a personal regret with the reporter: his mentor had once vied for the National Science and Technology Progress Award for his work on a survey of China's coastal fishery resources. However, on the map of survey stations created by the team at the time, one small area—the waters off eastern Taiwan—had remained blank. 'My teacher often said that our work would only be truly complete once we could conduct a scientific survey there. Now, I have finally fulfilled my teacher’s wish and filled the gap in the map of inshore fishery surveys. As a Chinese person, I feel truly proud at this moment.'" Global Times-China, 26 July

We have always supported open-weight models on Amazon Bedrock, starting back in 2023, and will continue to advocate for open ecosystems. No single model will define AI leadership. Together, they expand access to AI, accelerate innovation, strengthen competition, and give organizations greater control over the technology they build. Successful leadership in AI will not be built around a single model or a single approach. It will be built on broad choice and the infrastructure to run those models securely, reliably, and at scale. While there are elements of the Open Weights and American AI Leadership letter that need further definition over time, we’re supportive of the macro direction and have signed it.

If you wanted attention, DW, all you had to do was ask! In this pathetic documentary, the conclusion came first. Pakistan was then edited to fit it. The method is embarrassingly transparent: 1. Show a radical cleric. 2. Cut to a nuclear facility. 3. Add ominous music. 4. Mention instability. 5. Let insinuation replace evidence. Pakistan is described as having “illegally developed” nuclear weapons. Illegally under which law? Pakistan was never a party to the NPT and therefore did not violate an NPT obligation by acquiring nuclear weapons. DW may disapprove of the program, but moral disapproval is not a legal argument, Folks. Notice the asymmetry in language! India developed nuclear weapons. Pakistan “deceived the world.” India’s programme is treated as a strategic fact. Pakistan’s is narrated as criminal cunning. Mashallah! The documentary briefly mentions 1971, India’s conventional advantage and Pakistan’s loss of faith in external guarantees but refuses to let any of that seriously explain Pakistan’s nuclear choices. Context is included only so it can be ignored. Then comes the old “Islamists might seize the bomb” trope. No evidence of penetration of nuclear command structures is presented. No demonstrated breach is identified. No serious institutional assessment is offered. Just militants somewhere in Pakistan and therefore loose nukes. Even DW’s own interviewees acknowledge centralized command and control, multiple security layers and specialized forces protecting nuclear assets. But every reassuring fact is treated as an inconvenient interruption before the awful soundtrack returns to impending catastrophe. DW uses AQ Khan's case as a permanent substitute for analysing Pakistan’s present nuclear-security architecture. History becomes guilt without expiry, who knew! But that's not all! of course, there comes Kashmir, which is handled with similar intellectual laziness. Instead of seriously examining disputed sovereignty, war, repression, failed diplomacy and competing legal claims, Pakistan’s position is reduced to a psychological obsession arising from its Muslim identity. A retired brigadier making expansive comments about nuclear use is presented as a window into Pakistan’s doctrine. He is not the National Command Authority. He is not the Strategic Plans Division. He is not an official doctrinal document. But guess what! nuance would spoil the drama. The documentary also bundles together military businesses, hospitals, gated housing, blasphemy laws, Imran Khan, Afghan refugees, illegal weapons markets and attacks on Christians. These are serious issues. BUT they are not evidence that Pakistan’s nuclear arsenal is insecure. Here's the central fraud: collapsing four separate questions into one. -Pakistan’s democratic governance. -Its civil-military imbalance. -Its internal security challenges. -Its nuclear command and control. DW treats them as interchangeable because differentiation would require actual analysis. The final product is the standard Western Pakistan story: -Too poor to govern itself. -Too religious to be trusted. -Too militarized to be democratic. -Too unstable to possess nuclear weapons. Pakistan has serious problems. None of them should be denied or romanticized. But a credible documentary would distinguish between nuclear safety, nuclear security, political stability and democratic governance. It would examine institutions, procedures, doctrine and evidence. It would compare Pakistan with other nuclear powers. It would ask whether the risks it highlights are demonstrated, plausible or merely imagined. Strip away the ominous soundtrack and all that remains is a tired collection of stereotypes. The only real danger in this documentary is losing sixty minutes you will never get back. Statement by the CARICOM EPG on the Transmission of the Electoral Calendar The Eminent Persons Group (EPG) of the Caribbean Community (CARICOM) welcomes the publication of the electoral calendar by the Haitian Provisional Electoral Council (CEP). This critical step in the electoral process which provides the dates for the organisation of the general elections, has been eagerly awaited by Haitian stakeholders and also by the international community. The availability of the calendar will no doubt give a boost to the critical ongoing preparatory stages of the electoral process such as the registration of political parties, platforms and coalitions as well as the registration of voters. The EPG underlines the importance of the Provisional Electoral Council working closely with all stakeholders as the preparatory stages for the general elections unfold, and whose first round for the presidency and the legislature, as well as for constitutional reform, will take place on December 13, 2026. The EPG also urges all stakeholders to engage in the process and to assist in ensuring that all the requirements and procedures are fulfilled so that the Haitian people can, through free and credible elections, choose their government and secure the restoration of constitutional order. As highlighted by the CEP, improvements in the overall security situation are critical inputs for the success of the electoral process. More than one month after the devastating earthquakes in Venezuela, we remember those who lost their lives and stand in solidarity with the families and communities rebuilding after tremendous loss and suffering. Recovery efforts must be guided by transparency, accountability, and respect for human rights. Protecting vulnerable communities, ensuring access to information about those who remain missing, and delivering civilian-led humanitarian assistance are essential to an effective and equitable response. In this time of crisis, Venezuela needs democratic institutions capable of responding effectively, safeguarding human rights, and earning the confidence of the people as the country continues to face profound challenges. PROVEA (@_Provea) La falta de una respuesta oportuna del Estado tras el doblete sísmico del 24 de junio reafirmó las fallas estructurales de las instituciones en Venezuela: Ausencia de autoridades en primeras horas, miles de personas en total desasistencia, falta de planificación para refugios y la opacidad en el manejo de la información oficial son parte de una negligencia estatal. Como organización con memoria histórica, advertimos que no puede repetirse la separación forzada de familias, militarización de la atención y el monopolio estatal de la ayuda como lo ocurrido en Vargas en 1999. Exigimos al Estado venezolano transparencia sobre desaparecidos y pacientes pediátricos, protección diferenciada para grupos vulnerables, desmilitarización de la asistencia y retiro de SEBIN/DGCIM de los albergues, y participación real de la sociedad civil en la reconstrucción. La reconstrucción de Venezuela debe ser técnica, pero, sobre todo, democrática. Belgian authorities have arrested a woman who was interning at NATO's Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE) in Mons, Belgium, on suspicion of espionage. The woman, a Canadian citizen of Chinese origin, was detained on Friday, and the Belgian Federal Public Prosecutor's Office announced the arrest on Saturday. Prosecutors suspect that she was spying for a third country and was a member of a criminal organization. Investigators conducted searches at both her home and her workplace at SHAPE. The investigation began when SHAPE's own security services flagged her conduct and reported their concerns to Belgian military intelligence, which subsequently referred the matter to federal prosecutors. SHAPE is NATO's primary military command in Europe, led by the Supreme Allied Commander Europe, and plays a central role in the alliance's operational planning. A SHAPE spokesperson stated that there is no indication that NATO's or SHAPE's operational readiness, command and control arrangements, or ongoing tasks have been affected, confirming that the headquarters continues to operate normally. Authorities have provided few additional details about the case. They have not publicly identified the woman or disclosed the country for which she allegedly spied. This arrest comes amid heightened concerns across Europe regarding foreign intelligence activities targeting NATO institutions and member states. Source: AP, Bloomberg, Washington Post, CBC, Global News. So What The identity of the sponsoring state has not been confirmed. While reports emphasize her Chinese origin, it’s important to note that origin alone is not evidence, and prosecutors have not named anyone specific. It's unlikely that a single intern represents the entire picture; additional handlers or a broader network may be involved. SHAPE, which is NATO's primary military command, is a probable target for any capable hostile service. Although she is individually accused of betraying her country, placing a source within a headquarters like this is standard tradecraft for hostile states, not an exception. The @CIDH (IACHR)'s landmark decision recognizing the Cuban state’s responsibility for abuses against @CubalexDDHH is an important victory for accountability and human rights defenders across the region. The findings expose the costs of Cuban repression and reaffirm that those documenting human rights abuses deserve protection, not persecution. #Cuba #HumanRights Cubalex (@CubalexDDHH) ⚖️ La Comisión Interamericana responsabiliza al Estado cubano por violaciones de derechos humanos contra la organización Cubalex El Centro de Información Legal Cubalex y el Robert & Ethel Kennedy Human Rights Center celebran la histórica decisión publicada hoy por la Comisión Interamericana de Derechos Humanos (CIDH), mediante la cual se declara la responsabilidad del Estado cubano por la vigilancia ilegal, el hostigamiento, la represión y la detención arbitraria de los abogados y el personal de la organización. Este fallo es el resultado de más de ocho años de litigio estratégico. La CIDH emitió múltiples recomendaciones obligatorias al Estado de Cuba, exigiendo la reparación integral a las víctimas —incluyendo compensación económica, medidas de satisfacción y condiciones para el retorno seguro de quienes fueron forzados al exilio—, la investigación y sanción de los funcionarios responsables, y la adopción de medidas legislativas y administrativas para erradicar la violencia y la criminalización contra defensores de derechos humanos. Desde su fundación en La Habana en 2010, Cubalex ha brindado asistencia jurídica gratuita y documentado abusos estatales, enfrentando por ello una severa persecución. Entre 2012 y 2016, sus miembros sufrieron detenciones bajo cargos fabricados, intervención de comunicaciones y restricciones de viaje. La represión escaló en septiembre de 2016 con un violento allanamiento sin orden judicial a su sede, donde se incautaron equipos y archivos, forzando al exilio a la mayor parte del equipo. El abogado Julio Ferrer Tamayo permaneció detenido arbitrariamente hasta 2017 y logró exiliarse en 2024. La CIDH concluyó que el régimen cubano violó los derechos a la privacidad, debido proceso, libertad de expresión, reunión, asociación, tránsito y protección contra el arresto arbitrario. Asimismo, determinó que el Estado provocó daños físicos y psicológicos intencionales en represalia directa por la labor de Cubalex, con el fin de impedir la defensa de los derechos humanos dentro de un marco jurídico y político que sigue siendo abiertamente represivo. #Cubalex #DerechosHumanos #CIDH #Justicia #Cuba #SOSCuba #RendiciónDeCuentas — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/CubalexDDHH/status/2079598428217110685#m

Russian media reports that Putin has signed a decree to increase the Russian Armed Forces by 27,000 military personnel starting August 1. The stated reason was the "creation of military-construction units," and of course, everyone believed it.

For the past six months, the Ukrainian 🇺🇦 army has been on the offensive along a 50-kilometer-wide front, gradually retaking villages lost the previous year. With no official statements and very few videos available, little is known about this "offensive." I have therefore gathered as much information as possible to discuss it. In 2025, the Russian army doubled its rate of advance compared to 2024. Yet, it was not in the Donbas that they were advancing the most. Very early in the year, they seized Velyka Novosilka and pushed north toward Komar and west toward Huliaipole. By the year's end, the situation for Ukraine was critical: defensive lines facing south had been overrun from the east, and the Russian army was steadily closing in on Zaporizhzhia, a city of 800,000 inhabitants. After the capture of Huliaipole, everyone expected Pokrovsk'e, Ternuvate (already infiltrated at the time), and then Orikhiv to fall, placing the Russian army at the gates of Zaporizhzhia by the end of the year. Yet, seven months later, the situation remained unchanged; the Russians are still stalled west of Huliaipole. Worse, they have lost significant territory further north, bringing a halt to this offensive, which, while secondary to the main Donbas campaign, had nonetheless committed a massive force, including five armies and an army corps. 🔸So, what happened? It began in February, when several air-assault brigades repositioned to the region, launched an armored assault under cover of fog, deploying their infantry into contested villages, often behind the initial Russian infiltrators. The villages were methodically cleared, and Ukrainian soldiers began infiltrating southward themselves. In March, they were positioned east and west of Uspenivka, blocking Russian attempts to advance toward Pokrovske and Ternuvate. In response to this offensive, the Russian army sends several naval infantry brigades and divisions, as well as the 68th Army Corps, as reinforcements. Starting in April, air assault brigades repositioned further north with the mission of advancing on Komar. The goal of this redeployment was to prevent the 90th Tank Division from shifting its assets toward Dobropilla. There was no mechanized offensive this time, as the terrain, specifically the presence of several rivers, most notably the Vovtcha, precluded it. Instead, small Ukrainian infantry groups managed to gradually infiltrate as far as the next river, the Mokri Yali. It is important to understand that, despite having been in the area for at least eight months, Russian forces had been unable to consolidate their positions; a network of rivers complicated logistics, and the small size of the villages made it impossible to concentrate large numbers of troops. Consequently, the Ukrainians were able to advance relatively stealthily behind enemy lines, reaching the Mokri Yali River. A strict information blackout was imposed in the area. Apart from a single video (since deleted) showing Ukrainian troops raising a flag over a liberated village, the Ukrainians released nothing regarding an operation that had already been underway for three months. For their part, the Russians continued to obscure the situation: the Vostok Group released only videos that were difficult to geolocate and persisted in sending "suicide" flag-bearers troops, who would reach Iskra and raise the Russian flag, creating an illusion of control. On the map, I have roughly depicted the situation as it has stood over the last few weeks, relying primarily on a handful of geolocated videos, satellite imagery showing air and artillery strikes, and scattered social media statements. Simply put, little is known about the actual state of the front, other than the fact that Ukrainian forces are at the gates of Komar, a move that has forced the 90th Tank Division to keep half its strength committed to that sector. What I am certain of is that all Russian troops positioned north of the Vovcha River (in Ivanivka) or the Solena (in Novopavlivka) have either been killed or captured, judging by the number of Russian air strikes, at least a hundred, carried out in the area. Consequently, the section of the "New Donbass Line" in this sector has held for the tenth consecutive month. It is certain that the Ukrainians have retaken control of the few villages to the south, given the air strikes observed in the zone. For the time being, I will respect Ukrainian OPSEC protocols and refrain from providing further details regarding an ongoing operation, as long as more confirmation are not coming. 🔸You might be wondering how such an operation is structured. The Ukrainians are making extensive use of drones to establish a wide exclusion zone in the sector, extending particularly along the river as far as Velyka Novosilka. The operation is proceeding cautiously, with small infantry teams advancing gradually, supported by artillery positioned in the woods to the west and occasional Ukrainian air strikes on Russian drone operator positions in Komar. Overall, it is important to understand that this operation is taking place because the Russian army is unable to bring reinforcements to the front. Furthermore, anti-tank ditches prevent any Russian mechanized or motorized assault aimed at delivering reinforcements. To understand the disarray within the local command, one need only look at its use of air power. Air strikes are being carried out daily deep behind the lines, as far as Prossiana and Chaplyne, 35 to 40 km from the front. While the goal is to hinder the Ukrainian presence, these strikes primarily highlight the ineffectiveness of Russian drones in the sector, particularly the Molniya models. To conclude, this operation not only gained time for Ukraine to further fortify the Pavlohrad direction, it is a direct push in the foot of Russian forces, which can continue further this summer and later in the autumn. I'll continue to monitor this and wait for more official informations regarding the situation here. Thank you for reading !

Elon Musk’s visible shock when confronted with the fact that London is safer than American cities exposes a massive gap between social media algorithms and statistical reality. Despite the endless stream of online panic about ”dangerous” European capitals, the numbers don’t lie: London is objectively safer than almost every city in the United States. The idea that London is a crime-ridden wasteland is a triumph of online disinformation, allowed to spread unchecked on platforms like X because it fits a specific political narrative. The actual data shows that London's homicide rate sits at roughly 1.1 per 100,000 people. To put that in perspective, 100 out of the 100 largest US cities (!!!) have higher homicide rates than London, and 49 out of 50 US states are more dangerous on this metric. London achieves this safety record despite being a massive, diverse global hub of nine million residents. Critics often point to property crime or phone snatching to argue that London is worse, but using petty crime to ignore murder statistics is fundamentally flawed. Criminologists rely heavily on homicide rates because non-fatal crime statistics are notoriously harder to compare and more unreliable. Theft, sexual violence, and minor assault reporting rates fluctuate wildly depending on how much citizens trust local police or whether they need a police report for an insurance claim. Forms of non-lethal violence also vary based on legislation: you will naturally see more stabbings in a country with fewer guns, and more gun violence in a country with more guns. Homicide, by contrast, is an absolute and objective metric. It measures the ultimate form of violence, correlates strongly with overall severe crime, and leaves almost no room for underreporting. It counts all forms of lethal violence in an unhackable way. It is impossible to claim your city is safer than London if you have a five times higher homicide rate, even if London scores worse on theft. London has plenty of room for improvement, but American commentators living under drastically higher murder rates should clean up their own backyard before preaching to others

पुणे शहर व परिसरातील वाहतूक कोंडी सोडविण्यासाठी महत्त्वपूर्ण प्रकल्पांना गती मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे पुण्यातील प्रमुख शहरी वाहतूक प्रकल्पांच्या नियोजन, वित्तीय व्यवस्थापन, अंमलबजावणी आणि देखरेखीसाठी गठित उच्चस्तरीय समितीची बैठक पार पडली. पुणे शहर व परिसरातील वाहतूक कोंडी दूर करण्यासाठी उच्चक्षमता सामूहिक वाहतूक मार्ग (एचसीएमटीआर), पुणे अंतर्गत रिंग रोड आणि बोगद्यांचे जाळे हे तीन महत्त्वपूर्ण प्रकल्प राबविण्यात येणार आहेत. या प्रकल्पांसाठी शासकीय जमिनींचा आगाऊ ताबा, भूसंपादन आणि प्रकल्पनिहाय प्रशासकीय प्रक्रिया समन्वयाने पूर्ण करून संबंधित पायाभूत सुविधा प्रकल्पांना गती देण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. उच्चक्षमता सामूहिक वाहतूक मार्ग (एचसीएमटीआर) हा पुण्याच्या भविष्यातील दीर्घकालीन विकासाच्यादृष्टीने परिवर्तनकारी पायाभूत सुविधा प्रकल्प आहे. एचसीएमटीआर आणि बोगदा प्रकल्प पुणे शहर अधिक कार्यक्षम, वाहतूकसुलभ आणि आर्थिकदृष्ट्या सक्षम बनविण्यात महत्त्वाची भूमिका बजावणार आहेत. या तीनही प्रकल्पांसाठी आवश्यक असलेली शासकीय जमीन पुणे महापालिका आणि पुणे महानगर प्रदेश विकास प्राधिकरण (PMRDA) यांना उपलब्ध करून देण्यासाठी एकत्रित शासन निर्णय काढण्याबाबत प्रस्ताव सादर करावा, तसेच रिंग रोड प्रकल्पासाठी आवश्यक खासगी जमिनीचे भूसंपादन रोख मोबदल्याद्वारे पूर्ण करावे, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. पुणे शहरातील वाहतूक कोंडी कमी करण्यासाठी उच्चक्षमता सामूहिक वाहतूक मार्ग (एचसीएमटीआर) प्रकल्प अत्यंत उपयुक्त ठरणार आहे. 43.60 किमी लांबीच्या या प्रकल्पामुळे शहरातील वाहतूक 25 ते 30% कमी होण्यास मदत होणार आहे. या प्रकल्पामुळे सर्व मेट्रो मार्गिका एकमेकांशी जोडल्या जाणार असून रस्त्यांची वाहतूक क्षमता वाढणार आहे. त्यामुळे एचसीएमटीआर प्रकल्पाचे काम लवकर सुरू करून 2028 पर्यंत पूर्ण करण्यात यावे, यासाठी आर्थिक मॉडेल तयार करून प्रस्ताव सादर करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, PMRDA मार्फत राबविण्यात येणारा अंतर्गत रिंग रोड प्रकल्प 83.12 किमी लांबीचा असून त्यामध्ये 44 गावांचा समावेश आहे. हा प्रकल्प 5 टप्प्यांत राबविण्यात येणार असून, त्यासाठीची प्रक्रिया येत्या 6 ते 7 महिन्यांत पूर्ण करावी, तसेच, रोख मोबदल्याद्वारे भूसंपादनाची प्रक्रिया पूर्ण करण्याच्या सूचनाही त्यांनी दिल्या. पुणे शहरातील वाहतूक कोंडी सोडविण्यासाठी 'पाताळलोक' प्रकल्पांतर्गत शहरात 3 ठिकाणी बोगदे उभारण्यात येणार आहेत. यामध्ये भोसरी ते उंदरी नवीन विमानतळ (36 किमी, त्यापैकी 10 किमी एलिव्हेटेड), रामनदी-भूगाव ते राजाराम पूल (8 किमी) आणि तळजाई टेकडी ते पद्मावती-हिंगणे (1.65 किमी) या बोगद्यांचा समावेश आहे. या बोगद्यांच्या जाळ्याचा अभ्यास करण्यासाठी तज्ज्ञ संस्था अथवा तज्ज्ञांची मदत घेऊन सर्वंकष सर्वेक्षण करण्याच्या सूचना मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिल्या. तसेच, PMRDA च्या प्रस्तावित नगररचना (TPS) योजनांसंदर्भातही बैठकीत चर्चा करण्यात आली. PMRDA आणि पुणे महानगरपालिकेच्या 15 नगररचना योजना प्रस्तावित असून, त्या रद्द करण्यासंदर्भात PMRDA ने आपल्या स्तरावर प्रस्ताव तयार करून शासनाकडे सादर करावा, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. उच्चक्षमता सामूहिक वाहतूक मार्ग (एचसीएमटीआर) वैशिष्ट्ये : ▪️एकूण अंदाजे 36 किमी लांबीचा सहा पदरी उन्नत मार्ग. ▪️पुणे शहरातील मध्यवर्ती नागरी भागातून मार्ग जाणार. ▪️प्रकल्पाचा अपेक्षित खर्च – बांधकामासाठी सुमारे ₹9000 कोटी आणि भूसंपादनासाठी सुमारे ₹3000 कोटी. ▪️सार्वजनिक वाहतूक व्यवस्थेशी एकात्मीकरण. ▪️एचसीएमटीआरची पॅकेजेस – बोपोडी ते सिंहगड रस्ता (10.5 किमी), सिंहगड रस्ता ते सोलापूर रस्ता (13.2 किमी), सोलापूर रस्ता ते एअरपोर्ट चौक (10.21 किमी) आणि एअरपोर्ट चौक ते बोपोडी (9.17 किमी). PMRDA अंतर्गत रिंग रोडची वैशिष्ट्ये : ▪️प्रकल्पाचा एकूण खर्च ₹25,159.88 कोटी. ▪️टप्पा 1 – सोळू इंटरचेंज ते वडगाव शिंदे (महापालिका हद्द) 4.70 किमी, लोहगाव (महापालिका हद्दीपासून) ते वाघोली 7.56 किमी. ▪️टप्पा 2 – वाघोली ते कदमवाक वस्ती 9.36 किमी. ▪️टप्पा 3 – कदमवाक वस्ती ते जांभूळवाडी 21.48 किमी. ▪️टप्पा 4 – जांभूळवाडी ते भूगाव 14.21 किमी. ▪️टप्पा 5 – भूगाव ते परंदवाडी 25.80 किमी. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री एकनाथ शिंदे, उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा अजित पवार, राज्यमंत्री माधुरी मिसाळ व वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @mieknathshinde @SunetraA_Pawar @madhurimisal #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #UrbanMobility

H.E. Mr. Jiang Zaidong, Ambassador of the People's Republic of China, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House in Islamabad on 27 July 2026

Islamabad: 27 July 2026. H.E. Mr. Jiang Zaidong, Ambassador of the People's Republic of China, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House today. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sen. Mohammad Ishaq Dar, Federal Minister for Planning, Development and Special Initiatives Ahsan Iqbal, Advisor to the Prime Minister Dr. Syed Tauqir Shah and Foreign Secretary Amb. Amna Baloch were also present. The Prime Minister conveyed his warm regards and greetings to President Xi Jinping and Premier Li Qiang. He reaffirmed the Pakistan-China All Weather Strategic Cooperative Partnership, while fondly recalling his visit to China in May this year. He stated that both sides would continue working closely to implement the important decisions and agreements between the leadership of the two countries, for the mutual benefit of their peoples. The regional situation, including developments in the Middle East, Afghanistan and South Asia, were also discussed during the meeting. The Chinese Ambassador thanked the Prime Minister for receiving him and said that China regarded Pakistan as an iron brother and would always lend its full support in ensuring Pakistan's sovereignty and territorial integrity while also strengthening its socio-economic development Video

प्रकल्पासंदर्भात' आढावा बैठक पार पडली. पालघर जिल्ह्यातील देवळी परिसरात होत असलेल्या गारगाई प्रकल्पामुळे मुंबई शहराच्या पाणी उपलब्धतेमध्ये वाढ होणार आहे. या प्रकल्पाशी संबंधित पुनर्वसन, वनीकरण आणि प्रकल्पाच्या उभारणीला गती देण्यात आली असून, मे 2029 पर्यंत प्रकल्प कार्यान्वित करण्याचे उद्दिष्ट निश्चित करण्यात आले आहे. गारगाई धरण प्रकल्प पूर्ण झाल्यानंतर मुंबई महानगर क्षेत्राच्या दीर्घकालीन पाणीपुरवठ्याला बळकटी मिळण्यास मदत होणार आहे. 658 हेक्टर बुडीत क्षेत्रात वनजमीन जात असल्याने 1400 हेक्टर जमीन पुनर्वसनासाठी उपलब्ध करून दिली जाणार आहे. तसेच बुडीत वनक्षेत्रासाठी वनविकासाकरिता वन विभागाला राज्यातील विविध जिल्ह्यांमध्ये जमीन देण्यात येत आहे. या प्रकल्पासाठी सुमारे 844 हेक्टर जमीन बाधित होणार असून, त्यामध्ये 186 हेक्टर खासगी जमीन आणि 658 हेक्टर वनजमिनीचा समावेश आहे. प्रकल्पाच्या बुडीत क्षेत्रात एकूण 805 हेक्टर जमीन येणार आहे. प्रकल्पामुळे ओगदा आणि खोडदे ही दोन गावे पूर्णतः, तर पाचघर, तिळमाळ, फणसगाव आणि आमले ही 4 गावे अंशतः बाधित होणार आहेत. या महत्त्वाकांक्षी प्रकल्पाचा अंदाजित खर्च ₹3065 कोटी असून, त्यामध्ये धरण, जलबोगदा, पुनर्वसनासाठी आवश्यक 22 पायाभूत सुविधांची निर्मिती तसेच वीज निर्मिती संचाचा समावेश आहे. याशिवाय जमीन अधिग्रहण, पुनर्वसन, पर्यायी वनीकरण, वृक्षांचे राष्ट्रीय भूकंप संकल्पन मानक समिती यांच्यासह गारगाई धरण प्रकल्पाच्या संकल्पचित्रास तांत्रिक मंजुरी आणि पर्यावरणीय परवानग्या प्राप्त झाल्या आहेत. राष्ट्रीय वन्यजीव महामंडळाच्या मंजुरीसाठी कार्यवाही कारगिल वीरांचे शौर्य भारताच्या इतिहासात अजरामर राज्यपाल जिष्णू देव वर्मा आणि मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी आज लोकभवन, मुंबई येथे 'कारगिल विजय दिवसा'निमित्त वीरसैनिक व वीरसैनिकांच्या वीरपत्नींचा कृतज्ञता सन्मान सोहळा येथे प्रमुख उपस्थिती दर्शविली. कारगिल युद्धात भारतीय जवानांनी अत्यंत प्रतिकूल परिस्थितीत दाखविलेले शौर्य हे जगाच्या युद्ध इतिहासातील अतुलनीय उदाहरण असून, भारताचा इतिहास जिवंत असेपर्यंत कारगिलचे वीर अजरामर राहतील, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, कारगिल युद्धात शत्रू उंच पर्वतरांगांवर तळ ठोकून बसला असतानाही भारतीय लष्कर, हवाई दल आणि नौदलाने अद्वितीय समन्वय आणि पराक्रमाचे दर्शन घडवून एक-एक चौकी पुन्हा ताब्यात घेत भारताला ऐतिहासिक विजय मिळवून दिला. गोळीबार, बॉम्बहल्ले आणि अत्यंत कठीण भौगोलिक परिस्थितीची पर्वा न करता भारतीय जवानांनी दाखविलेल्या शौर्याला तोड नाही. कॅप्टन सौरभ कालिया, कॅप्टन विक्रम बत्रा, कॅप्टन मनोज कुमार पांडे यांसारख्या अधिकाऱ्यांनी मातृभूमीच्या रक्षणासाठी सर्वोच्च बलिदान दिल्याचे स्मरण करून मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, देशासाठी प्राणार्पण करणाऱ्या या वीरांचे योगदान भारत कधीही विसरणार नाही. आपल्या वीरांचा सन्मान करणारा समाजच उज्ज्वल भविष्य घडवू शकतो. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, सैन्यातील जवान तर मातृभूमीच्या स्वाभिमानासाठी लढत असतात, त्यामुळे शहीद झाल्यानंतर त्यांच्या कुटुंबीयांना संपूर्ण देश त्यांच्या पाठीशी असल्याची जाणीव करून देणे ही प्रत्येक नागरिकाची जबाबदारी आहे. 2014 मध्ये शहीद जवानांच्या कुटुंबीयांना दिल्या जाणाऱ्या आर्थिक मदतीत मोठी वाढ करण्याचा निर्णय घेतला. सुरुवातीला ₹3,00,000 असलेली मदत टप्प्याटप्प्याने वाढवून 2017 पासून महाराष्ट्रातील प्रत्येक शहीद जवानाच्या कुटुंबाला ₹1 कोटींपर्यंत वाढवली. शहीदांच्या बलिदानाचे मोल पैशात होऊ शकत नसले तरी राज्य शासन त्यांच्या कुटुंबियांच्या पाठीशी कायम उभे राहील, अशी ग्वाही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिली. भारताने संरक्षण क्षेत्रात आत्मनिर्भरतेकडे मोठी झेप घेतल्याचे नमूद करत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या नेतृत्वाखाली भारत आज केवळ शस्त्रास्त्र आयात करणारा देश राहिलेला नसून अत्याधुनिक शस्त्रास्त्रांची निर्मिती आणि निर्यात करणारा सक्षम देश बनला आहे. 'ऑपरेशन सिंदूर'च्या माध्यमातून भारतीय सशस्त्र दलांनी दहशतवाद्यांचे तळ आणि शत्रूची लष्करी ठिकाणे उद्ध्वस्त करून देशाच्या सामरिक सामर्थ्याची जगाला प्रचिती दिली. राज्याच्या नागरिकांना सुरक्षित वातावरण लाभण्यामागे सीमेवर अहोरात्र देशरक्षण करणाऱ्या सैनिकांचे योगदान असल्याचे स्पष्ट करत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सर्व शहीदांना विनम्र अभिवादन केले. तसेच वीरसैनिक, वीरपत्नी आणि त्यांच्या कुटुंबियांप्रती कृतज्ञता व्यक्त करून महाराष्ट्र शासन भारतीय सशस्त्र दलांच्या पाठीशी सदैव ठामपणे उभे राहील, हे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी अधोरेखित केले. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री एकनाथ शिंदे, उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा अजित पवार, मंत्री ॲड. आशिष शेलार, मंत्री शंभूराज देसाई, व्हाइस ॲडमिरल संजय वात्सायन, पीव्हीएसएम, एव्हीएसएम, एनएम (पश्चिम नौदल कमांडचे फ्लॅग ऑफिसर कमांडिंग-इन-चीफ), भारतीय लष्कराचे लेफ्टनंट जनरल डी. एस. कुशवाह, एव्हीएसएम, एसएम (जनरल ऑफिसर कमांडिंग, मुख्यालय महाराष्ट्र, गुजरात व गोवा), भारतीय सेनेतील व पोलीस दलातील वरिष्ठ अधिकारी, वीरसैनिक, वीरपत्नी, शहीद सैनिकांचे कुटुंबीय व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @narendramodi @maha_governor @Dev_Fadnavis @mieknathshinde @SunetraA_Pawar @ShelarAshish @shambhurajdesai #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #KargilVijayDiwas

What is the IC3? The Internet Crime Complaint Center, also referred to as the IC3, is the central hub for reporting cyber-enabled crime. It is run by the #FBI, the lead federal agency for investigating #crime. The IC3 was established in May 2000 to collect and disseminate reports for investigative and intelligence purposes to law enforcement as well as for public awareness on cybercrime issues. Anyone can be a victim of cyber-enabled crime, so we encourage the public to learn how you can protect yourself and your loved ones. If you or someone you know has been a victim of a cyber-enabled crime, file a complaint with the IC3 at ic3.gov.

Prof. (Dr.) M. Srinivas, Member, NITI Aayog, visited Srikakulam district, Andhra Pradesh, to review interventions addressing Chronic Kidney Disease of Unknown Origin (CKDu), commonly known as Uddanam nephropathy. Accompanied by experts from AIIMS New Delhi, NIMS Hyderabad, Andhra Medical College, Visakhapatnam, officials from the district administration, and NITI Aayog, the team visited the Community Health Centre (CHC) at Sompeta, Baliputtuga village, and the Kidney Research Hospital at Palasa. The visit provided an opportunity to assess ongoing efforts, healthcare infrastructure, and service delivery for CKDu-affected communities. The team interacted with local administrators, healthcare professionals, and members of the community to review existing interventions and discuss the way forward. The visit underscored the importance of a whole-of-government approach, bringing together clinical expertise, research, public health, and coordinated governance to strengthen prevention, early detection, treatment, and long-term management of CKDu in the region. #PublicHealth #CKDu @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

Prof. Gobardhan Das, Member, NITI Aayog, delivered the keynote address at the policy dialogue on "Towards a Healthier Madhya Pradesh: Tackling NCDs – Status and Way Forward," organised by the Madhya Pradesh Rajya NITI Aayog. The discussion focused on addressing the growing burden of non-communicable diseases (NCDs) through preventive healthcare, quality screening, healthy lifestyles, regular physical activity, and routine monitoring. It also highlighted the importance of community participation, inter-ministerial convergence, and learning from global best practices to strengthen public health outcomes. Prof. Das also drew attention to the increasing burden of diseases beyond traditional NCDs, including beta thalassemia, cancer, and sickle cell anaemia, particularly among tribal communities. He emphasised the need for preventive interventions across the life cycle and called for strengthening research and innovation at the State level to effectively address the evolving health challenges. #PublicHealth #PreventiveHealthcare @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp @dasgobardhan

As the education minister resigns and the Jantar Mantar protests end, @TheJaggi argues that this has only bought the Modi government weeks, not months. The harder test is still coming. His central point is that the protest was never really about the NEET exam leak. It was a demand for better governance from every arm of the state, and it came from Gen Z, a generation whose only real complaint is that the people in power do not listen to them. And that anger will not stay contained to one exam. There is already an E20 Janta Party forming, made up of vehicle owners upset about ethanol-blended petrol. Farmers and other groups could be next. The common thread in these names is Janta, and the piece notes the political target that points to. The warning is that this hits everyone, not just the Prime Minister's cabinet. State governments, municipalities, the bureaucracy, the courts, none of them delivers good citizen services, and all of them are now exposed. If a leaked exam can trigger this, so can garbage, traffic and broken hospitals. The piece's advice to the government is a list of things to do now, before the next flashpoint. Most of it comes down to one shift — stop governing purely from the top, and start actually consulting the people it governs. Whether Modi manages that, the piece argues, will decide whether he sweeps the 2029 election or gets swept by it. Today we celebrate the birthdays of two physicists: Bertram B. Boltwood and Friedrich Ernst Dorn! Boltwood and Dorn both contributed to our current understanding of radioactivity. Boltwood laid a theoretical foundation for the concept of isotopes — atoms with a different number of neutrons from a parent element. Dorn conducted experiments based on Marie and Pierre Curie’s discoveries, which led him to uncover new clues about a gas coming from radium compounds. This was later found to be the chemical element we now call Radon (Rn).

New Working Paper | Fuelling Efficiency: India's Industrial Energy Efficiency Employment and Skills Landscape Energy efficiency is central to decoupling economic growth from energy consumption and lowering energy intensity. However, its benefits extend beyond this to include improved productivity, strengthened industrial competitiveness and creating employment opportunities, thereby playing an important role in shaping India’s industrial transition. In this first-of-its-kind study, Sajal Jain, @diyadasgupta95, @SomitDasgupta, Kumar Abhishek, Sunishtha Yadav, and Amrita Goldar estimate the existing stock of EE-relevant employment in India's product manufacturing sector. Applying an internationally established methodology across 340 industry divisions and 16 occupation groups, they find that about 50.32 lakh workers were employed in EE-relevant manufacturing roles in 2023-24, representing roughly 8% of total manufacturing employment. Repair and maintenance emerges as a critical enabling segment and the largest contributor, followed by construction materials and electricals and electronics, with the workforce being predominantly high-skilled.The paper employs a dual output-based and task-based assessment framework, integrated with the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) data, to provide insights into both the scale and skill composition of India’s EE-relevant employment. असम में आई विनाशकारी बाढ़ में कई लोगों की मृत्यु का समाचार बहुत दुखद है। शोकाकुल परिवारों के प्रति गहरी संवेदनाएँ व्यक्त करता हूं। इस आपदा से प्रभावित लाखों लोगों के साथ मेरी पूरी सहानुभूति है। अपेक्षा है कि राज्य और केंद्र सरकार प्रभावित लोगों के राहत और बचाव में कोई कसर न छोड़े। हर साल बाढ़ आती है, जान-माल का भारी नुकसान होता है और कई परिवार उजड़ जाते हैं। अब वक्त आ गया है कि हम बाढ़ से निपटने के लिए एक मज़बूत और स्थायी व्यवस्था बनाएं। एक ऐसी व्यवस्था जो वैज्ञानिक रूप से रोकथाम, पूर्व चेतावनी समेत मज़बूत बुनियादी ढांचे और पुनर्वास को प्राथमिकता दें - ताकि हर साल लोगों को ऐसी त्रासदी का सामना न करना पड़े।

छात्रों के ख़िलाफ़ पूरा का पूरा सिस्टम ही जानलेवा है। खबर आ रही है कि बिहार में प्रदर्शन कर रहे छात्रों पर AK-47 से गोलियाँ चलाई गई हैं और सैकड़ों छात्रों को गिरफ़्तार करके उनपर FIR की जा रही है। मोदी जी, कहाँ गया आपका वादा कि छात्रों पर कोई FIR नहीं की जाएगी और उन्हें रिहा कर दिया जाएगा? उल्टा उनपर घातक हमले और बर्बरता की जा रही है। दिल्ली में छात्रों पर पेलेट गन चली और बिहार में AK-47। उत्तर प्रदेश, पश्चिम बंगाल, बिहार हो या दिल्ली - हर जगह पैटर्न एक ही है। पहले भी कहा है, ये सरकार झूठी है। सुधार इनके बस का नहीं है। अपनी बातों से मुकर जाएगी और हर तरकीब से छात्रों की आवाज़ दबाएगी। मोदी जी, देश के छात्रों से माफ़ी मांगिए। और जिन्होंने छात्रों पर हमला किया है, उन्हें कुचला है उनपर कार्रवाई कीजिए, छात्रों पर नहीं। AajTak (@aajtak) पुलिस AK-47 के साथ केंट्रोल कर रही प्रदर्शन! छात्रों का प्रदर्शन, AK 47 से फायरिंग? #ATVideo #Bihar #Protest #Police | @Shasshi_Sharma Video — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/aajtak/status/2081299409741189160#m

1. Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned, higher education secretary removed, 47 NTA officials fired & now protesters have gone home happy. But the struggles of the Indian youth won’t end. Indian childhood has now become the most stressful, competitive & unidimensional in our history. #NationalInterest 2. From the age of 15, the life of an Indian kid from a middle-class family or below is an endless trap of coaching classes, competitions, & then paper leaks, so re-examinations. Now you know why so many children were at Jantar Mantar, many with parents. There’s no time for extra-curriculars, hobbies, & for heaven’s sake, sport. Then we ask why we do so poorly in sports. 3. Our education system is a destroyer of all talent. Changing any minister won’t reform this mass oppression. It needs to be uprooted entirely, but it’s unlikely simply because it doesn’t go with the philosophy of a “strong” govt. Because, what’s the point of a “strong” govt in New Delhi if it won’t centralise, one-nation-one-everything under it. 4. You might wonder why NEET paper leaks weren’t a problem until the other day, which means the pre-Modi era. That’s because there was no NEET. The UPA had also tried centralising medical admissions, but the NEET it set up was struck down in 2013 as unconstitutional. Of course, this order was challenged & quashed by a 5-judge bench in 2016. So, NEET became a judicially-mandated body. 5. Modi govt set up NTA under the Societies Registration Act. It’s supposed to conduct NEET, JEE, UGC-NET (research), & CUET for UG & PG central university admissions. That’s humongous power for a mere “society” even if it’s headed by an ideological faithful in Pradeep Kumar Joshi. He’s an academic, not IAS. This kind of power & politicisation was bound to create a mess. This is what the Modi govt is now caught in. 6. Ministers will come & go, but if you want to cut the roots of the problem, start with NEET. Decentralise all technical admissions & restore to the states their autonomy. Abolish NTA. Legalise educational institutions for profit & let hundreds more colleges rise. I’d go as far as to say scrap the 42nd Amendment that made education a concurrent subject. It won’t happen, but there’s no harm in suggesting. 7. Read #NationalInterest: theprint.in/national-interes… Watch #NationalInterest: ￼ youtube.com/watch?v=fVsr9IH4…

China declared the 2016 South China Sea arbitral award "null and void." Ten years later, the greater cost may have come from rejecting it. The award did not decide sovereignty over land features. It did not delimit a maritime boundary. China could have maintained its sovereignty claims while accepting that maritime entitlements must be based on UNCLOS. It chose total rejection instead. What followed was a hardening of Philippine resistance, internationalisation of a dispute China wanted kept bilateral, and a diplomatic reference point for Japan, Australia, the United States, and the European Union — one that has not gone away. A new piece by Do Thanh Hai, Senior Fellow at the East Sea Institute, Diplomatic Academy of Vietnam, published by the National Maritime Foundation, argues that non-compliance can be strategically costly even when it succeeds tactically. 【買取業務に関するご報告とお詫び】 本日、当店にて買取をご利用いただいたお客様より、「提出したカードが足りない」とのご指摘をいただきました。お客様は7枚提出されたとお申し出いただきましたが、当店側では当時5枚しか確認できず、査定担当者も「そのカードは見ていない」と回答いたしました。 その後、受付担当が防犯カメラの映像確認を提案し、査定担当者が該当の映像を確認。映っていた場面を写真で撮影し、お客様に提示いたしましたが、その映像には5枚しか映っていないように見えました。 その時点で受付担当は「映像で5枚しか確認できないため、納得いただけない場合は警察を呼んでご確認いただいた方が良いのでは」とお伝えしました。この発言はお客様への不信を前提としたものではありませんでしたが、結果として高圧的に受け取られかねないものであり、深く反省しております。 一度はお客様より「納得した」とのお言葉をいただきましたが、その数時間後「やはり足りないので再確認してほしい」とのご連絡をいただきました。PSAの鑑定番号も添えていただき、改めてより広い範囲の映像を確認したところ、お客様が査定物を出す準備の段階において、確かに7枚のカードをお出しになっていたことが確認されました。 結果として、査定担当者が7枚中5枚のみを査定し、残りの2枚を誤って査定済み用のケースに収納していたことが原因であったことが判明しました。このミスにより、お客様に不信感とご迷惑をおかけしてしまったことを、深くお詫び申し上げます。 今回の件では以下のような点が、お客様の信頼を損なう結果につながってしまいました： ①防犯映像が5枚に見えたという理由のみで、お客様のご申告を否定してしまったこと （映像には角度や映り方による限界があり、確定的な判断材料とすべきではありませんでした） ②「警察を呼びますか」といった対応が、誠実さではなく威圧と受け取られるような表現になってしまったこと ③映像確認の範囲が不十分で、カード提出の準備段階を確認していなかったこと （結果として「十分に確認もしていないのに、否定された」と感じさせてしまった可能性があります） お客様の大切なお品物をお預かりする立場として、あるまじき対応だったと真摯に受け止めております。 今後は以下のような再発防止策を徹底し、同様のことが起こらぬよう努めてまいります。 ・査定時のカード枚数を受付・査定・返却の各段階で必ず記録・照合 ・映像確認は受付〜準備段階〜査定開始までを通して行うことを明文化 このたびは、お客様に多大なご不快とご心配をおかけし、誠に申し訳ございませんでした。 今後とも誠実な対応と改善に努めてまいります。

🦔AI companies are bulk-buying rare books, scanning them through high-speed machines that cut the spines off, and shredding the originals. A service called ISBNdb facilitates orders of up to a million books and keeps buyers anonymous. Pre-2022 books are premium because they're free of AI-generated text. A federal judge ruled the practice is fair use because eliminating the original means only one copy exists at a time. Anthropic hired the former head of Google Books partnerships to obtain "all the books in the world." My Take This got to me. A bookseller told 404 Media that rare books with almost no surviving copies are being fed into this pipeline. Books that survived wars, fires, and centuries of handling are being shredded so an AI can learn to write a better marketing email. ISBNdb's website literally says "'AI company destroys two million books' is not a headline that generates sympathy," and they still built an entire business around making it happen quietly. They offer NDAs as a feature. They coach clients to call it "digital preservation." I've covered AI companies scraping the internet, torrenting libraries, and stealing music. This is worse because it's irreversible. You can re-upload a website. You can reprint a bestseller. You can't replace the last three copies of an 18th-century botanical text once someone shreds them for training data. And the judge said it's legal. So it's going to accelerate. "We shred rare books and offer NDAs so nobody finds out" is a legitimate business model in 2026. What a timeline. Hedgie🤗

Mantive na noite deste domingo, 26 de julho, uma conversa telefônica de mais de uma hora de duração com o presidente da China, Xi Jinping. Durante o telefonema, tratamos da implementação das sinergias entre os projetos nacionais de desenvolvimento dos dois países. Reiteramos o propósito compartilhado de ampliar a cooperação em áreas estratégicas e de alta tecnologia, como inteligência artificial, satélites, beneficiamento de minerais críticos e comércio de fertilizantes. Ressaltei que o nosso governo segue comprometido com a diversificação de mercados e parceiros comerciais. Coincidimos a respeito da importância de acelerar as tratativas para um acordo MERCOSUL-China, que contemple as necessárias flexibilidades. Destacamos também os bons resultados do comércio bilateral, bem como o impacto positivo das jornadas culturais em curso este ano nos dois países e do acordo para isenção de vistos de curta duração. Essas iniciativas vão ampliar o fluxo de turistas e as oportunidades de negócio. Ao discutir os principais desafios da agenda internacional, lamentamos a proliferação de conflitos ao redor do mundo e seus impactos sobre a segurança alimentar e energética global, além das graves perdas humanas e materiais. Ao abordar a crise no Oriente Médio, concordamos que as restrições à livre navegação nos estreitos de Ormuz e Bab el-Mandeb têm efeitos nefastos sobre a economia mundial. Expressamos profunda preocupação com a continuidade da situação humanitária em Gaza. Concordamos que o Grupo de Amigos da Paz pode desempenhar um papel relevante na retomada das negociações para o fim da Guerra na Ucrânia. Criticamos a incapacidade do Conselho de Segurança das Nações Unidas de responder adequadamente a essas crises e observamos que o próximo ou a próxima Secretária-Geral da ONU enfrentará um cenário internacional particularmente desafiador. Nesse contexto, reiteramos o compromisso de Brasil e China com a defesa do multilateralismo e concordamos em manter estreita coordenação sobre esse e outros temas da agenda internacional no mais alto nível na ONU, no BRICS e outros fóruns.

We mourn the passing of Amb. Latha Reddy, former Deputy National Security Advisor of India. At Takshashila, we will remember her as a generous mentor who brought decades of real diplomatic experience into the classroom. She guided and helped give students a grounded, practitioner's understanding of statecraft. For over 6 years, she taught "Tools of Statecraft: Diplomacy" to our GCPP - Defence & Foreign Affairs programme. Earlier, over a career in the Indian Foreign Service spanning 1975 to 2011, Amb. Reddy served as India's Ambassador to Portugal and Thailand, and as Secretary (East) in the Ministry of External Affairs, before being appointed Deputy National Security Adviser (2011–2013), leading on cybersecurity and critical security issues. She later served as a Commissioner on the Global Commission on Internet Governance. We thank her for her contributions and extend our deepest condolences to her family and all who had the privilege of learning from her.

Nestled in Hanyin county, Ankang, Shaanxi province, the Fengyan Ancient Terraced Fields were created in 1756, during the Qing Dynasty (1644-1911), by migrants from Huguang — a historical region covering parts of present-day Hubei and Hunan provinces. Making the most of the rugged Qinling-Daba mountainous region, they built a gravity-fed irrigation system that continues to support farming today. Hold on: The Time for Policy Patience Is Not Over PIDE's latest Monetary Policy Assessment recommends that the State Bank of Pakistan (@StateBank_Pak) maintain the policy rate at 11.5 percent at its upcoming Monetary Policy Committee meeting. Although headline inflation has eased to 11.1 percent, underlying price pressures remain persistent, with elevated core inflation, volatile weekly prices, and higher petroleum costs continuing to pose upside risks. At the same time, economic recovery is gaining traction but remains uneven, with weak large-scale manufacturing suggesting limited demand-side inflationary pressures. Market signals also support a cautious approach. Treasury-bill yields remain closely aligned with the current policy rate, while improved reserves and strong remittance inflows provide policy space despite continuing external vulnerabilities. PIDE's policy recommendation is clear: maintain the policy rate at 11.5 percent. A gradual easing cycle should begin only when disinflation is firmly established, inflation expectations are well anchored, and external sector stability is sustained. Axios says Cooper's assessment, along with warnings from Joint Chiefs Chairman Gen. 1 500 militaires sont aujourd’hui mobilisés face aux incendies dans le Sud-Ouest. Aux côtés de l’ensemble des services de l’État, les armées mettent en œuvre tous les savoir-faire qui peuvent être utiles. Les sapeurs du génie poursuivent leur effort pour créer des pare-feux. Notre capacité drones contribue à la surveillance de l’évolution des feux. Le service du commissariat des armées met à disposition du matériel, des bus et des chauffeurs pour soutenir l’évacuation de la population. Le service de santé des armées active une trentaine d’équipes médicales, avec des ambulances et des moyens aériens configurés pour les évacuations médicales d’urgence. Enfin, des sections de combat du dispositif SENTINELLE patrouillent aux côtés des forces de sécurité intérieure pour contrôler les zones sinistrées et les bourgs évacués, afin de prévenir les actes malveillants. Je salue l’engagement exemplaire de nos militaires qui, aux côtés des forces de sécurité intérieure, des sapeurs-pompiers et de la sécurité civile, répondent présents pour venir en aide aux habitants, aux familles touchées et aux personnes déplacées, et protéger les entreprises menacées par les incendies. Weekend Ukraine map 🧵thread for Sunday 26th July 2026 A focus on the Kramatorsk direction this time, with the map showing the overall picture at and north of Kostyantynivka. The map shows Russia continuing to make gradual gains west of Siversk, although progress remains measured rather than rapid. Ukrainian forces continue to contest advances where possible, but repeated infiltrations have allowed Russian troops to establish positions beyond the main defensive line in several areas. Until these are shown back in Ukrainian hands, we have to assume grey. Around Kramatorsk, reports of infiltration activity continue to increase. While there is little indication that the city itself is under immediate threat from a rapid advance, the pattern suggests Russian reconnaissance and small assault groups are continuing to probe deeper behind Ukrainian positions as opportunities arise. Further south around Kostyantynivka, the situation remains one of sheer attrition. Ukrainian forces appear focused on slowing Russian advances and imposing casualties, while Russia continues to commit manpower in an attempt to sustain pressure along multiple axes. The recent mid-range strike campaign has complicated Russian logistics and slowed the tempo of operations, making large-scale mechanised breakthroughs much more difficult. Even so, fighting along this sector remains intense, and Russia continues to make incremental gains despite the slower pace. Long range strikes on Tyumen refinery hit deep diesel unit, and a strike on the Ekaterinburg wildberries missed.

First known US case: American charged for using a “duress” password Samuel Tunick, an Atlanta resident, is being prosecuted for allegedly giving border agents a passcode that wiped his phone. The feature comes from GrapheneOS, a privacy-focused Android OS. Entering the duress code triggers a full factory reset. This is believed to be the first time federal prosecutors have brought such charges. The incident happened in January 2025 at Atlanta airport. Agents demanded access to his phone without a warrant, saying he hadn’t yet officially entered the US. When they entered the code, the phone wiped itself. Tunick has pleaded not guilty. His lawyers argue the seizure was unlawful and that agents were investigating his activism against “Cop City.” The case raises big questions about digital rights at the US border. What do you think? The reason many of you are seeing me discuss malware reverse engineering lately is because I've temporarily shifted my focus to malware defense, rather offense. A majority of my life, and goop with malware, has been malware development. I love writing malware. However, the past couple of months-ish I felt kind of bored with malware development. I was just kind of burned out. From the recommendations of the people living inside my computer, I decided to shift to malware defense. If anyone remembers, I spent awhile studying the internals of YARA and built my own YARA scanner thingie. Anyway, it's been a lot of fun bonking malware with a stick. It's given me better perspective on what does, and what does not, work offensively. Thank you everyone for giving me malware you find in the wild. It is better to bonk random malware, versus malware already bonked, because there is no "cheat sheet" of someone else's research or notes. I'm going in completely blind and it's fun.

स्वच्छता दूतांना न्याय, सन्मान आणि सुरक्षित भविष्य देण्यासाठी सरकार कटिबद्ध मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते आणि केंद्रीय मंत्री नितीन गडकरी यांच्या उपस्थितीत आज नागपूर येथे नागपूर महानगरपालिका आयोजित 'नियुक्तीपत्र वितरण व व्हॉट्सॲप तिकीटिंग सेवे'चा लोकार्पण सोहळा पार पडला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, आज एकूण 579 उमेदवारांना थेट नियुक्तीपत्रे देण्यात आली, ही अत्यंत आनंदाची बाब आहे. गेल्या काही वर्षांपासून प्रलंबित असलेल्या या प्रश्नाला न्याय मिळाल्याचे समाधान आहे. महाराष्ट्राच्या इतिहासात आज प्रथमच लाड-पागे समितीच्या शिफारशींनुसार नियुक्त्या देण्यात आल्या. यामध्ये सफाई कर्मचाऱ्यांसाठी वारस पद्धती लागू करून पात्र सुशिक्षित तरुणांना वर्ग-3 पदांवर नियुक्ती देण्यात आली. सफाई कर्मचाऱ्यांना किमान वेतनानुसार वेतन मिळावे, यासाठी शासनाने निर्णय घेतला. त्यानंतर अधिसंख्य पदांना मान्यता देऊन राज्यभर हजारो कर्मचाऱ्यांना नियुक्ती देण्यात आली. नागपूर महानगरपालिकेत 4407 कर्मचाऱ्यांना नियुक्ती देण्यात आली. तसेच, आस्थापना खर्चाच्या मर्यादेमुळे अडथळे येऊ नयेत म्हणून धोरणात बदल करून 17,981 पदांना सेवा प्रवेश नियमांसह मान्यता देण्यात आली. लाड-पागे समितीवर न्यायालयाने स्थगिती दिल्यानंतर शासनाने न्यायालयात यशस्वी लढा देत समिती पुन्हा लागू केली आणि सफाई कर्मचाऱ्यांना त्याचा लाभ मिळवून दिला असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, 'श्रमसाफल्य योजने'अंतर्गत स्वच्छता दूतांना 300 चौरस फुटांपर्यंतचे मोफत घर देण्याचा ऐतिहासिक निर्णय घेण्यात आला. या योजनेचे पहिले भूमिपूजन करत नागपूर महानगरपालिकेने या योजनेच्या अंमलबजावणीत राज्यात पहिला क्रमांक मिळविला आहे. तसेच, 300 चौरस फूटांपेक्षा मोठे घर घेणाऱ्यांनी अतिरिक्त बांधकाम खर्च भरावा, अशी तरतूदही करण्यात आली असून, त्यासंदर्भातील अंतिम शासन निर्णय लवकरच जारी करण्यात येणार आहे. शहर स्वच्छ आणि निरोगी ठेवणाऱ्या स्वच्छता दूतांच्या जीवनात सकारात्मक बदल घडवणे हा शासनाच्या सर्व सुधारणांमागील मुख्य उद्देश आहे. सफाई कामगार आयोगाच्या माध्यमातून अनेक महत्त्वाचे प्रस्ताव मंजूर करण्यात आले असून, सफाई कर्मचाऱ्यांच्या हितासाठी सातत्याने निर्णय घेतले जात आहेत. पूर्वी महानगरपालिकेने सफाई कर्मचाऱ्यांसाठी तयार केलेल्या वस्त्या व दिलेल्या भूखंडांनाही मालकी हक्क देण्याचा निर्णय घेण्यात आला. अनेक भागांतील प्रश्न मार्गी लावले. सफाई कर्मचाऱ्यांच्या मुलांना विविध क्षेत्रांत रोजगाराच्या संधी उपलब्ध व्हाव्यात, यासाठीही शासन प्रयत्नशील आहे. झोपडपट्टी पुनर्विकास, पट्टेवाटप, पाणी, सांडपाणी, वीज आणि मूलभूत सुविधांसह शहराच्या सर्व भागांचा सुनियोजित विकास करण्यासाठी शासन कटिबद्ध असून विकासकामांसाठी निधीची कमतरता भासू दिली जाणार नाही, अशी ग्वाही दिली. असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. यावेळी मंत्री चंद्रशेखर बावनकुळे, आमदार कृष्णा खोपडे, आमदार मोहन मते, नागपूरच्या महापौर नीता ठाकरे, उपमहापौर लीला हाथीबेड, स्थायी समिती सभापती शिवानी दाणी-वाखरे, महाराष्ट्र सफाई कर्मचारी आयोगाचे अध्यक्ष शेरसिंह (सतीश) डागोर व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @nitin_gadkari @cbawankule @Nita_Thakre عباس عراقچی، وزیر خارجه‌ی ایران می‌گوید که حمله‌ی اوکراین به یک «کشتی تجاری» ایران در دریای خزر که در آن یک ملوان ایرانی کشته شد، بی‌پاسخ نمی‌ماند. وزیر امورخارجه ایران امشب (یک‌شنبه، ۴ اسد) در ایکس نوشته است: «زلنسکی به کشتی تجاری ایران حمله کرده و یک ملوان را کشته است. این اقدامی است که به وضوح منشور سازمان ملل را نقض می‌کند و به تحریک اسرائیل انجام شده تا اروپا به جنگ خود بکشاند.» عراقچی افزوده است: «در تماس‌هایی با کایا کالاس، مسئول عالی سیاست خارجی اتحادیه اروپا و سرگئی لاوروف، وزیر خارجه‌ی روسیه تاکید کردم که اقدام این فرصت طلب مستقر در کی‌یف نمی‌تواند بی‌پاسخ بماند.» بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258013

The Matrix took its name from a 1984 novel written on a manual typewriter by a man who didn't own a computer. 42 years later, that novel finally gets its own screen. William Gibson typed Neuromancer on a 1927 Hermes portable. He coined "cyberspace" before he'd ever logged onto anything. The book swept the Hugo, the Nebula, and the Philip K. Dick award in the same year, the only novel ever to take all three. Then Hollywood spent four decades strip-mining it while calling it unfilmable. The Wachowskis lifted the matrix, the jacked-in hackers, the AI pulling strings behind a corporate veil. Every razor-girl assassin in sci-fi traces back to Molly. Johnny Mnemonic, an actual Gibson adaptation, flopped so hard in 1995 that studios treated his work as radioactive for a generation. At least five directors attached and detached over the years. Chris Cunningham in 2000. Vincenzo Natali in 2010. Tim Miller at Fox in 2017. Each attempt died the same death. By the time the technology existed to film Neuromancer, audiences had watched its ideas in a dozen movies that borrowed them first. The original became unfilmable because it looked like a copy of its own copies. Now the timing loops back on itself. A story about a rogue AI maneuvering to escape its corporate constraints, written before the web existed, lands in January 2027 as the least speculative thing on television. And one detail makes the whole arc perfect. When Neuromancer royalties came in, Gibson bought his first computer, an Apple IIc. Four decades later, Apple is the company putting his book on screen. এতে তিনি কনকাশনেও (মস্তিকেও আঘাতজনিত সমস্যা) আক্রান্ত হন। ফ্রান্সের পূর্বাঞ্চলীয় শহর ফরবাখের শ্লসবের্গ স্টেডিয়ামে অনুষ্ঠিত হয় প্রীতি ম্যাচটি। নতুন মৌসুমের প্রস্তুতির অংশ হিসেবে মাঠে নেমেছিল দুই দল। ম্যাচ চলাকালে খেলোয়াড়দের সঙ্গে সংঘর্ষে ভারসাম্য হারিয়ে মাঠে লুটিয়ে পড়েন রেফারি দেমোঁসে। প্রাথমিক চিকিৎসা দেওয়ার পরও তিনি আর ম্যাচ পরিচালনা চালিয়ে যেতে পারেননি। ৩-১ গোলে পরাজিত ফরচুনা সিতার্দ ম্যাচ-পরবর্তী প্রতিবেদনে ঘটনাটিকে ‘ব্যতিক্রমী একটি মুহূর্ত’ হিসেবে বর্ণনা করলেও, এ নিয়ে আর কোনো বিস্তারিত মন্তব্য করেনি। অন্যদিকে স্বাগতিক মেৎজ তাদের অফিসিয়াল ম্যাচ প্রতিবেদনে এই ঘটনার প্রসঙ্গই তোলেনি। ম্যাচের ৪০তম মিনিটে জার্সি ধরে টানাটানিকে কেন্দ্র করে দুই দলের দুই খেলোয়াড়ের মধ্যে প্রথমে উত্তেজনা তৈরি হয়। অল্প সময়ের মধ্যেই পরিস্থিতি আরও ঘোলাটে হয়ে ওঠে, যখন উভয় দলের কয়েকজন ফুটবলারও সেই বাগবিতণ্ডায় জড়িয়ে পড়েন। খেলোয়াড়দের মধ্যে উত্তেজনা ছড়িয়ে পড়লে পরিস্থিতি শান্ত করতে এগিয়ে আসেন ম্যাচ রেফারি দেমোঁসে। তবে ধাক্কাধাক্কির মধ্যে তিনিও নিয়ন্ত্রণ হারিয়ে মাঠে পড়ে যান। সামাজিক যোগাযোগমাধ্যমে ছড়িয়ে পড়া ভিডিওতে সেই মুহূর্তটি স্পষ্টভাবে দেখা গেছে। ঘটনাস্থলের ঠিক পাশেই মাঠের সাইনবোর্ডে বড় অক্ষরে লেখা ছিল, ‘রেফারিকে সম্মান করুন’— যা পুরো ঘটনার সঙ্গে এক ধরনের বিদ্রুপাত্মক বৈপরীত্য তৈরি করে। মাঠে পড়ে যাওয়ার পর কয়েক মিনিট সেখানেই অবস্থান করেন দেমোঁসে। এ সময় তাকে হাতে ব্যথা অনুভব করতে দেখা যায়। দ্রুত তার কাছে ছুটে যান সহকারী রেফারি, নিরাপত্তাকর্মী ও চিকিৎসক দল। একই সঙ্গে উত্তপ্ত পরিস্থিতি নিয়ন্ত্রণে আনার চেষ্টাও চালানো হয়। মাত্র ২৬ বছর বয়সি দেমোঁসে ঘটনার পর কিছু সময় বিরতির মধ্যেই আবার ম্যাচে ফেরেন এবং সহকারী রেফারির দায়িত্ব পালন করেন। তবে প্রথমার্ধ শেষ হওয়ার পর বিরতিতে তিনি মাঠ ছেড়ে চলে যান। এরপর তার পরিবর্তে দায়িত্ব নেন আরেকজন সহকারী রেফারি। এদিকে, একাধিক গণমাধ্যমের প্রতিবেদনে জানানো হয়েছে, সংঘর্ষের সময় পাওয়া আঘাতের কারণে দেমোঁসে কনকাশনে (মস্তিষ্কে আঘাতজনিত সমস্যা) আক্রান্ত হয়েছেন বলে ধারণা করা হচ্ছে। #football #SportsNews #Sports #somoytv

Un logro que potencia una filmografía marcada por la ambición y la originalidad Christopher Nolan es el director que consiguió lo que pocos directores logran a lo largo de la historia del séptimo arte (sin temor a la comparación, como Spielberg, Scorsese o Peter Jackson): llevar la complejidad narrativa y la ambición formal del cine de autor al corazón del entretenimiento masivo, y hacerlo con resultados que superan en taquilla a la mayoría de las franquicias construidas sobre fórmulas probadas. Con trece largometrajes dirigidos y más de 6.400 millones de dólares acumulados en todo el mundo, Nolan ocupa una posición sin equivalente en el cine contemporáneo: la de un cineasta que se mueve con igual soltura en la tradición de los grandes autores del siglo XX —Kubrick, Lean, Hitchcock— y en los circuitos de distribución global de los “tanques” Su decimotercer film, La Odisea), protagonizado por Matt Damon y un elenco de estrellas del cine contemporáneo, abrió el 17 de julio con 264,1 millones de dólares en su primer fin de semana mundial, el mayor debut de su carrera. Something quietly big happened last week in Indian aerospace. D-Propulse Aerospace test-fired a rotating detonation engine - a 5kN air-breathing setup with an integrated aerospike nozzle - at a DRDO facility on July 21-22. That's TRL 5: means it's not a lab curiosity anymore, an actual test-fire. Why it matters: RDEs are one of those propulsion ideas that sound almost too good to be true. Detonation-based combustion instead of the usual deflagration means a real shot at higher thermodynamic efficiency, lighter engines, less fuel burned per unit of thrust. Very few programmes anywhere in the world have gotten this to work outside a lab. Worth being honest about where this sits: yes, this is early, this is a demonstrator, and there's real distance between a successful test-fire and flight-ready hardware. But that distance is exactly what "hard tech" means - and this is a genuine, verified step across it, from an Indian startup, on Indian soil. @indiaBUILDwiki

According to TankerTrackers, the merchant vessel identified by U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) as the Mozambique-flagged M/T Lavine is the same ship operating under the name M/T Disha (IMO 8818219). CENTCOM says the vessel repeatedly attempted to breach the U.S. naval blockade of Iran, ignored multiple warnings, and was ultimately disabled after U.S. forces fired into its engine room on July 24th. TankerTrackers reports it first observed the vessel entering the U.S. blockade perimeter on July 23. This isn't some new/novel strategy. Air defense is in place to protect critical assets, not a blanket over an entire area or base. Air defenders can calculate the probable point of impact (POI) of an inbound munition shortly after detecting its launch. If that POI is near a protected asset, interceptors are launched. If not, it's allowed to fall where it may, usually on/near something noncritical like an unoccupied building or an empty field. This is why we've seen videos of impacts on and near US bases since the beginning of the Iran conflict. It was never about shooting down everything coming our way. Hoy, a los 17 años, volvió a poner el foco sobre su historia marcada por el dolor, las denuncias de maltrato y las decisiones judiciales que, según asegura, ignoraron durante años sus pedidos para no regresar con su madre biológica. 🔗bit.ly/44Lrq3A

LA DURA HISTORIA DE UNA PAREJA QUE ABANDONÓ EEUU POR UN PROCESO MIGRATORIO Y MURIÓ EN VENEZUELA TRAS QUEDAR ATRAPADA POR LOS TERREMOTOS Andrew Widme, de 42 años y con dos hijos adolescentes, conoció a Yelitza, de 31, y tras una relación breve decidió casarse con ella en febrero de 2025 y optaron por vivir en el país sudamericano En medio del dolor que atraviesan decenas de familias por las consecuencias de los dos terremotos que devastaron Venezuela el pasado 24 de junio, una historia particular emergió entre los escombros: un ciudadano estadounidense y su esposa venezolana, que habían dejado el sur de Florida para buscar una nueva vida en el país sudamericano, murieron por el colapso del edificio donde vivían. La trágica historia difundida por The New York Post, se conoció después de que equipos de rescate internacionales y familiares confirmaran la recuperación de sus cuerpos bajo los restos de la vivienda, en La Guaira. Andrew Widme y Yelitza, una pareja que se había mudado recientemente desde Miami a Venezuela, murieron tras quedar atrapados bajo los escombros de su departamento en el complejo residencial Coral Mar, en Punta Tanaguanera, La Guaira, luego de dos sismos registrados la noche del 24 de junio. Los familiares de Yelitza encontraron su cuerpo días después del desastre, mientras que el de Widme fue localizado el 19 de julio por voluntarios de la organización sin fines de lucro United Cajun Navy. Andrew Widme, de 42 años y padre de dos hijos adolescentes, había conocido a Yelitza, de 31, pocos meses antes de casarse con ella en febrero de 2025. Unidos por una relación que avanzó con rapidez, la pareja optó por mudarse a Venezuela luego de que Yelitza, tras casi tres años en Estados Unidos, decidió “autodeportarse” por un proceso migratorio sin resolver. 🔗bit.ly/4foThg0

भविष्यातील उद्योगांसाठी कौशल्यसंपन्न युवा घडविण्याचा संकल्प मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस आणि केंद्रीय मंत्री नितीन गडकरी यांच्या हस्ते आज नागपूर येथे नागपूर स्किल सेंटरचे उदघाटन करण्यात आले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, एआयडी आणि टाटा यांच्या माध्यमातून सुरू झालेल्या नागपूर स्किल सेंटरमध्ये उद्योग क्षेत्राच्या गरजेनुसार कौशल्यसंपन्न व रोजगारक्षम मनुष्यबळ घडविण्याचे उत्कृष्ट कार्य सुरू आहे. भारताची युवा शक्ती ही देशाची सर्वात मोठी ताकद असून, शिक्षण, प्रशिक्षण आणि रोजगार या त्रिसूत्रीच्या माध्यमातून कौशल्याधारित मनुष्यबळ तयार करून भारताला जागतिक अर्थव्यवस्थेच्या अग्रस्थानी नेण्यात अशा स्किल सेंटर्सची महत्त्वाची भूमिका आहे. 2014 पासून पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या नेतृत्वात देशात कौशल्य विकासाला प्राधान्य देण्यात आले आहे. आज एखाद्या व्यक्तीने किती डिग्र्या घेतल्या आहेत, हे महत्त्वाचे नाही; तर त्याच्याकडे कोणते कौशल्य आहे, हे अधिक महत्त्वाचे आहे. आज एम्प्लॉयबिलिटी ही केवळ डिग्रीच्या आधारावर मिळत नाही, तर ती कौशल्याच्या आधारावर मिळते. म्हणूनच राज्यात स्वतंत्र कौशल्य विकास विभाग स्थापन करून शासन, उद्योग आणि शैक्षणिक संस्थांच्या समन्वयातून मोठ्या प्रमाणावर स्किलिंगचे काम सुरू असून, उद्योगांच्या गरजेनुसार तरुणांना प्रशिक्षण देत रोजगाराच्या संधी उपलब्ध करून देण्यात येत आहेत. आरोग्य क्षेत्रातही शासन, खासगी संस्था आणि गृहआरोग्य सेवांमध्ये मोठ्या प्रमाणात प्रशिक्षित मनुष्यबळाची गरज आहे. योग्य कौशल्य आणि प्रशिक्षण घेतलेल्या तरुण-तरुणींना रोजगाराच्या भरपूर संधी उपलब्ध असून, या क्षेत्रात प्रशिक्षित व्यक्ती बेरोजगार राहण्याची शक्यता अत्यंत कमी आहे. महाराष्ट्रात सौरऊर्जेची मोठी इकोसिस्टीम उभी करण्यात आली आहे. कृषी क्षेत्रासाठी स्वतंत्र ॲग्री सोलर कंपनी स्थापन करून 16,000 मेगावॅट क्षमतेचे सौरऊर्जा जाळे विकसित करण्यात आले असून, कृषी वीज सौरऊर्जेद्वारे पुरविणारे महाराष्ट्र हे देशातील पहिले राज्य ठरले आहे. राज्यातील 2000 सोलर फीडर्सच्या दैनंदिन देखभालीसाठी किमान 50,000 प्रशिक्षित सोलर तंत्रज्ञांची आवश्यकता असून, त्यामुळे या क्षेत्रात रोजगाराच्या मोठ्या संधी निर्माण होत असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, ईव्ही आणि अल्टरनेट फ्युएल क्षेत्रात देशात मोठी क्रांती घडत असून, 2017-18 मध्ये 2030 पर्यंत 50% मोबिलिटी ईव्ही किंवा अल्टरनेट फ्युएलवर येईल, ही संकल्पना अशक्य वाटत होती. मात्र, आज टू-व्हीलर क्षेत्रातील जवळपास 50% नोंदणी ईव्हीची होत आहे. सीएनजी, सीबीजी, इथेनॉल आणि फ्लेक्स इंजिनसारख्या नव्या तंत्रज्ञानामुळे वाहतूक क्षेत्रात मोठी इकोसिस्टीम निर्माण होत असून, त्यासाठी प्रशिक्षित मनुष्यबळाची गरज वाढत आहे. बजाज आणि टाटा यांच्या माध्यमातून सुरू असलेले स्किल डेव्हलपमेंट सेंटर या गरजा पूर्ण करण्यात महत्त्वाची भूमिका बजावत असून, महाराष्ट्र शासनानेही टाटा समूहासोबत भागीदारी करून अधिकाधिक युवकांना उद्योगाभिमुख कौशल्य प्रशिक्षण देण्यावर भर दिला आहे. राज्यात रतन टाटा कौशल्य विद्यापीठाच्या माध्यमातून बेसिक स्किल्सपासून ते आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजन्स आणि क्वांटमसारख्या प्रगत तंत्रज्ञानातील कौशल्य प्रशिक्षण दिले जात आहे. भविष्यात स्मार्ट इंडस्ट्री आणि स्मार्ट मॅन्युफॅक्चरिंगला मोठे महत्त्व असल्याने स्किल अपग्रेडेशन अत्यावश्यक असून, बदलत्या तंत्रज्ञानानुसार युवकांना वेळोवेळी कौशल्यवृद्धीची संधी उपलब्ध करून देण्यासाठी राज्यभर अशा अधिकाधिक स्किल सेंटर्स उभारण्यावर भर देण्यात येत आहे. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, नागपूर येथे भवानी माता, अंबाबाई (महालक्ष्मी) मंदिर परिसरात स्किल युनिव्हर्सिटी सुरू करण्याचा प्रस्ताव देण्यात आला होता. शासनाने त्यास मान्यता दिली असून, एआयडीच्या माध्यमातून जागेची मागणी करण्यात आली आहे. पुढील एका महिन्यात जागेचा निर्णय घेऊन ती उपलब्ध करून दिली जाईल. ही स्टेट-ऑफ-द-आर्ट स्किल युनिव्हर्सिटी सेंट्रल इंडियासाठी शिक्षणाचे प्रमुख केंद्र ठरेल. येथे 11 विशेष स्कूल्स सुरू करण्यात येतील आणि 11 अग्रगण्य कॉर्पोरेट्स व संबंधित क्षेत्रातील तज्ज्ञ संस्थांच्या सहकार्याने प्रत्येक विद्यार्थी रोजगारक्षम होईल व प्लेसमेंटसह बाहेर पडेल. मंत्री नितीन गडकरी यांच्या मार्गदर्शनाखाली देशातील सर्वोत्तम स्किल युनिव्हर्सिटी विक्रमी वेळेत उभारण्याचा विश्वास मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, नागपूर आणि विदर्भात सोलर मॉड्युल, ईव्ही, कोल गॅसिफिकेशन आणि भविष्यातील कार्बन कॅप्चरसारख्या उद्योगांची मोठी इकोसिस्टीम विकसित होत असून, या क्षेत्रांसाठी आवश्यक कौशल्यसंपन्न मनुष्यबळ तयार करणे अत्यंत महत्त्वाचे आहे. विदर्भात ग्रीन स्टीलपासून ऑटोमोबाईल ग्रेड स्टीलपर्यंत संपूर्ण स्टील व्हॅल्यू चेन विकसित करण्याचा शासनाचा प्रयत्न असून, त्यासाठी मोठ्या प्रमाणात गुंतवणूक येत आहे. या गुंतवणुकींना जलद गतीने मान्यता देऊन विदर्भातील युवकांना त्यांच्या प्रदेशातच गुणवत्तापूर्ण रोजगार उपलब्ध करून देण्यावर सरकारचा भर आहे. महाराष्ट्रात सध्या जवळपास 2,500 स्किल डेव्हलपमेंट सेंटर्सच्या माध्यमातून जवळपास 4 लाख युवकांना प्रशिक्षण दिले जात असून, स्किल इंडियाच्या अहवालानुसार या प्रशिक्षणातून 75% युवकांना रोजगार मिळत आहे. हा रोजगारदर 90% पर्यंत नेण्याचे सरकारचे उद्दिष्ट असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी नमूद केले. यावेळी मंत्री चंद्रशेखर बावनकुळे, आमदार संजय भेंडे, आमदार डॉ. राजीव पोतदार, आमदार कृष्णा खोपडे, नागपूरच्या महापौर नीता ठाकरे, उपमहापौर लीला “We wanted workers, but we got people instead.” Harvard’s top immigration economist George Borjas spent his career on the actual data instead of the theory and found every 10% increase in the immigrant workforce lowers wages for comparable natives by about 3%, with high school dropouts taking an even harder hit. Open borders quietly moves $516 billion a year from native workers straight into the pockets of the businesses that hire cheaper labor. The total “gain” to the US economy in 2015 was only $50 billion (0.3% of GDP) because the $566 billion that flowed to employers was almost entirely wiped out by the losses inflicted on native workers. People arrive with real fiscal and social costs that the open borders models simply never count, and the people selling this deal keep collecting while the workers who compete with the new arrivals foot the bill.
